tips.text: Join a clan that already researched Kreska and Fieldron; you can buy the blueprint the same day and skip about a week of timers.
Treat Sentient Surge as the real goal; the gun is serviceable without it and a top room clearer with it.
Buy Sentient Surge with Nightwave Creds before trying Daughter's Mother Token shop.
Start the Kreska research and the first Fieldron before you gather; the lab and the Foundry each run one job at a time.
Skip perfect catches; each Charamote gives one Sagan Module at any grade, so bait and a cave pool are enough.
Stop feeding Helminth mid-farm; Thermal Sludge and Gorgaricus Spore are what it eats.
Nobody complains about the farm itself; the gathering is one evening and the research timers are the wait.
